recommendation: Implement comprehensive care coordination for substance use disorders
implementation_steps: Coordinate multidisciplinary care across medical, behavioral health, and social service providers
Facilitate referrals to specialized SUD treatment programs when needed
Ensure follow-up after care transitions to prevent treatment gaps
Monitor engagement and retention in treatment programs
Address barriers to care such as transportation and housing
evidence_summary: Care coordination interventions for substance use disorders have demonstrated improvements in treatment engagement, retention, and outcomes, particularly when addressing social determinants of health alongside clinical care.
